description: Shows a generated modeling diagram through the diagram editor canvas. The public InsertAtViewportCenterAsync(element) is the non-drag path (Fáze 6, WCAG 2.5.7): it creates the node at the CENTER OF THE VIEWPORT through the embedded editor's GetViewport() (the page center while no viewport is known — SSR, prerender, bUnit) via the same clamp/collision logic and the same OnNodeDropped contract the drop uses; AllowNodeDrop switches both paths.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Generated diagram document to show in the preview. Null renders the pre-generation empty state.

parameters.name: ActiveDraggedElement
parameters.description: Modeling element currently being dragged from the model tree.

parameters.name: AllowNodeDrop
parameters.description: When false, model tree drops are ignored without mutating the preview document.

parameters.name: ShowEditActions
parameters.description: Whether the preview header renders its edit actions (the "Generate diagram" and "Open in editor" buttons). Default true. The mobile layout (Fáze 7, G2) passes false: those entries live in the editor action bar and header overflow there, so the preview shows only viewer controls (the embedded editor toolbar).

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the preview root.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the embedded diagram editor reports a document mutation.

parameters.name: OnDrop
parameters.description: Raised when a dragged modeling tree item is dropped onto the preview canvas.

parameters.name: OnGenerateRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests a fresh diagram generation from the currently loaded model.

parameters.name: OnNodeDropped
parameters.description: Raised after a tree element is reused as a new diagram node.

parameters.name: OnOpenInEditor
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests opening the generated document in the full diagram editor.

parameters.name: OpenInEditorTriggerId
parameters.description: DOM id for the "Open in editor" trigger, owned by the hosting editor so its dialog can name the trigger as the focus-scope restore target. Null renders no id (the default).

parameters.name: OnRelationshipSelected
parameters.description: Raised when a relationship edge is selected in the generated preview.

parameters.name: ShowEmbeddedEditorChrome
parameters.description: Whether the embedded diagram editor renders its own chrome. Default true. The mobile band passes false: there the DE header bar would hold only the overflow trigger and the floating zoom pill duplicates the canvas pinch, so the preview shows the page tabs and the canvas. Reduction happens through the DE's public ShowToolbar parameter only.
